stem: Two substrates receive the same feed EC but show different root-zone EC trends. What is the best conclusion?
choices: Substrate water-holding, drainage and ion-buffering behavior can alter root-zone concentration, so feed EC alone is not enough
The two substrates must have identical root-zone chemistry
Only cultivar name can explain the difference
Feed EC should always be doubled in the higher-EC substrate
rationale: Media properties and water balance influence root-zone solute concentration. Equal input EC does not guarantee equal root-zone EC.
